identifiers.external: public_id (ULID, ADR 0009) of files, legal_documents, document_versions and organizational_units
identifiers.p08_d_f01: Academy InstructorAssignRequest accepts only `source_document` (legal_documents.public_id), resolved after the class authority; a numeric source_document_id is an unknown field (422); unknown/malformed/numeric/foreign/non-ACTIVE documents converge on the concealed 404

classification.unknown: FAIL_CLOSED: requested unknown => 422 CLASSIFICATION_INVALID; stored unknown => invisible, not downloadable, not attachable
classification.clearance: operation permission in scope => RESTRICTED; FILES_CONFIDENTIAL_ACCESS in scope => CONFIDENTIAL; FILES_HIGHLY_SENSITIVE_ACCESS in scope => HIGHLY_SENSITIVE (per owner unit)

storage.disk: files_private (driver local, no url, private visibility, never storage:link)
storage.root: FILES_STORAGE_ROOT outside public_path, the application and the repository; validated on every use (503 otherwise)
storage.storage_key: v1/<yyyy>/<mm>/<32 random hex>.bin (not derived from name or public_id)
storage.staging: staging/<same hex>.part, promoted by rename after the row exists

crypto.container: MEPAF1 = magic(6) | key_version u16 BE | XChaCha20-Poly1305-IETF nonce(24) | wrapped DEK(48, AAD mepa.files.content.v1|<public_id>|<key_version>) | secretstream header(24) | 64 KiB chunks + 17 bytes, TAG_FINAL on the last
crypto.dek: random per file, never stored usable in clear
crypto.kek_ring: FILES_KEYRING_PATH {active_version, keys{n:{kek}}}; older versions read-only; distinct from People keys
crypto.fail_closed: missing/misplaced/malformed ring, unknown key_version, unwrap/chunk/final-tag/checksum failure => 503, incident audited, no plaintext
crypto.rewrap: php artisan files:maintain rewrap: DEK re-wrapped under the active KEK into a new object (chunks copied), checksum verified, storage_key/key_version switched under lock, old object removed

pipeline: type verdict (extension allowlist, finfo MIME, magic, double extension) + image re-encode
tx: quota under unit FOR UPDATE + national named lock, INSERT QUARANTINED, audit file.uploaded
final gate tx: stored object re-verified => AVAILABLE | object destroyed + PURGED

consumers.others: no adapter in the foundation => concealed 404 (fail closed)
consumers.academy_guard: CONFIDENTIAL / HIGHLY_SENSITIVE files are not reachable from Academy until its adapter exists
